entries.canonical_text: After work, I take out my notebook at the evening high school I attend. I check if my phone still has any work messages. I want to avoid using it during class. But can I say with confidence, No matter what happens, I can stay away from work messages? I take both my work and my studies seriously. As an adult, I want to be responsible for both. I write what I want to tell the school in my notebook's margin. Before the bag is shut, I want the door to a talk to stay open. I do not want to give up my responsibility to manage how I use my phone, either.
